purpose: Read-only goalie and observed player-availability context at a proven pregame cutoff

scope.input: Synthetic offline NHL fixture archive only

missingness.player_unknown_without_team: Unattributed observation ID; never assigned to a team
missingness.absent_player_record: No inference of availability or roster completeness

interpretation: Only statuses and observations are descriptive. No injury weighting, probability, recommendation or wager is computed.
next_gate: Real provider rights and timestamps, broader data coverage, leakage audit and prospective evaluation require separate validation
